prevalence_denominator: all valid-date tickets, including noise (-1), within each window or calendar month

trajectory_rules.start_end: first and last supported target-quarter endpoints; not calendar-quarter averages
trajectory_rules.net_change: end minus start; null when fewer than two supported endpoints
trajectory_rules.slope: least-squares prevalence per actual elapsed day times seven; unsupported endpoints excluded
trajectory_rules.persistent: at least two supported endpoints, all selected endpoints supported, all positive prevalences >= persistence_threshold

caveats: Retrospective joint-space analysis: topic IDs must be assigned in a single stable joint topic space; no topic model is re-fit here. Joint fitting may use future information, so these are not leakage-free online emergence estimates.
Coverage and partial-period flags are inferred from minimum and maximum UTC ticket dates. Ticket dates do not prove complete collection, and partial-period comparisons can be biased.
All valid-date tickets, including noise (-1), are included in prevalence denominators.
An empty calendar quarter is missing data, not a zero-prevalence observation. Changes never bridge a missing immediate predecessor.
Thresholds are descriptive proportion-scale heuristics, not significance tests. Overlapping rolling windows are dependent observations.
Retrospective within-quarter trajectories retain prior-quarter trailing-window context; they do not estimate a quarter-to-quarter slope.
Monthly and target-quarter counts are nonoverlapping original-ticket counts. Rolling counts overlap and must not be added as ticket totals.
Coverage bounds are inferred from source ticket dates, not proof of complete collection.
